m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: So you met with success, did you?
The first step in creating a Bone Drake to summon is to get yourself a set of Drake bones.
Those are not so easy to come by, as you can imagine. Unfortunately, Dragonspyre has been picked clean!
A necromancer named Osseus Nightreaver dwells in Dragonspyre’s Necropolis. He’s a collector of Drake bones.
If any are to be had in all of Dragonspyre, Osseus is the one to get them from.
See if you can get some Drake bones from Osseus Nightreaver. He’s in the Necropolis, in Dragonspyre.
